conviction_note: Q3 was pre-released on 26 Oct (9M adj. EBIT ~DKK 506m, so Q3 ~188 against an 8-contributor Modular Finance consensus of 186 that was refreshed afterwards) and the FY26 guide was raised the same day, so the release on the evening of 9 Nov carries little new on the reported lines. What it can carry is a narrowing of a guide whose implied Q4 (DKK 154-179m) is flat on Q4 2025 (167) after +15-23% y/y in Q1-Q3, Q3 cash flow and working capital during the TMS roll-out, and possibly a new buy-back (the DKK 200m programme is 98% spent and expires 9 Nov). Those are small and mixed, so p_up is 52 and abs_move 3.0 (the pre-released-period base, in line with this name's +1.8 to +3.2% next-day reactions). The Capital Markets Day on 18 Nov falls outside the window and may hold back positioning. The findings sum to +0.55 and the scaled number is +0.12. The gap is the sign uncertainty, which sits in p_up and is not shrunk out of the findings.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 adj. EBIT is already out at about DKK 188m (9M ~506 less H1 318), against a post-upgrade consensus of 186 from 8 contributors, so the reported quarter lands on the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 26 Oct pre-release of this quarter moved the stock +8.0% (312.5 to 337.5), and the stock has since given it all back to 315.5. The Q2 beat (179 vs 173 consensus) was followed by +3.2% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The number was announced as inside information on 26 Oct and consensus (186) was refreshed on 2 Nov with all 8 contributors updated. It is filed at 0 for that reason.
findings.independence: https://mfn.se/a/modularfinance-estimates/ntg-nordic-transport-group-consensus-estimates-q3-2026 (consensus 186, a different document from the pre-release)

findings.finding: The raised FY2026 guide (adj. EBIT 660-685) implies Q4 2026 adj. EBIT of 154-179 against Q4 2025's 167, i.e. flat y/y at the midpoint after +15% (Q1 139 vs 121), +23% (Q2 179 vs 145) and +17.5% (Q3 ~188 vs 160). That leaves room for a narrowing toward the top or upbeat Q4 trading commentary in the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This year's guide moved 600-650 -> 625-650 (narrowed with H1; next day +3.2%) -> 660-685 (26 Oct, +8.0% on the day, fully reversed since). The company has beaten and raised all year.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public, but the stock has round-tripped the whole +8% upgrade day (337.5 -> 315.5) while the guide went up. If the market priced a Q4 beat-and-raise, the post-upgrade level would have held. Against that: the guide was set on 26 Oct with October partly in hand, the company says Air & Ocean freight rates are 'expected to decline due to an oversupply of freight capacity', and the 2026 guide excludes 2026 acquisitions. So the flat Q4 may be deliberate rather than sandbagged, and the finding is kept small.
findings.independence: Quarterly 2025 adj. EBIT (121/145/160/167) from the FY2025 annual report: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b6d4fa3fb9406df6768e3c6c545153929&lang=en&src=listed ; H1 2026 quarterly figures: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a3c5406f1f83f32f204d3e643f6c112b7

findings.finding: The DKK 200m buy-back is 98% spent (DKK 196.8m, 859,561 shares by 2 Nov) and expires 9 Nov at the latest. It has been buying 3,000-5,600 shares a day against 21-57k of daily volume, so the bid ends on the release date unless a new programme is announced with Q3. Programmes were previously launched alongside reports (Mar 2026 with FY25; Mar, May and Aug 2023 with results).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 4 Mar 2026 programme came out with the FY25 report and the medium-term-ambition update. That day the stock rose +6.7%, but the move cannot be separated from the results.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether a renewal comes on 9 Nov or is held for the 18 Nov CMD is not public. If a renewal were assumed, the stock would not have drifted -6.5% from the upgrade high while the old programme ran down. Leverage is 2.25x and the programme's stated purposes (Ring-the-Bell minority buy-outs, incentive schemes, M&A) are ongoing, so a renewal is plausible but not certain.

findings.finding: Special items were raised to about DKK 50m from 30-35m for the Air & Ocean reorganisation and the German Road restructuring. If a large part lands in Q3, reported profit could print below the 104m profit consensus even with adj. EBIT in line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean observation. Simply Wall St has headlined past NTG prints as 'EPS miss' on special items while the stock rose (Q3 2025 next day +3.0%).
findings.why_not_priced: The total is public, and it sits inside what the company already told the market, so the finding is near 0. Only the quarterly phasing is unknown, and the contributors updated after 26 Oct probably included it.

findings.finding: Q3 cash flow and working capital are not pre-released. In Q2 the German groupage TMS roll-out increased the drag on working capital (Q2 NWC release 97m vs 181m a year earlier, adj. FCF 225m vs 265m), and the company said the impact 'is expected to gradually improve'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separable observation on this name. On the European sample, cash outweighed a raised guide once (Luceco -5.5%).
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody outside the company has Q3 cash data. The 26 Oct pre-release gave EBIT only. The sign rests only on the company's own guidance language, hence the small size and wide range.

outside_window.finding: Capital Markets Day on 18 November 2026 in Copenhagen. Likely to bring new financial targets after the DKK 1,000m 2027 ambition was dropped on 4 Mar 2026 ('financial guidance will be provided on an annual basis going forward'), and possibly capital allocation and M&A. This is the larger scheduled event, and it may hold positioning back on 10 Nov.
